digitalOcean.firewall: Unchanged; owner-only game and SSH access

fixedDefects.name: Native save/restart blocks turns
fixedDefects.reproduce: Save a native room with no pending choices, restart, then StartTurn. JsonUtility materialized null choices as empty DTOs.
fixedDefects.expected: No pending choice; turn may start.
fixedDefects.change: Normalize only wholly empty optional DTOs, preserving all nonempty partial choice data.

fixedDefects.name: Partial pending choice with null Mode crashes
fixedDefects.reproduce: Restore a meaningful pending reward/deck choice whose Mode is null, then build choice options.
fixedDefects.expected: Preserve choice without a null dereference.
fixedDefects.change: Guard null/empty Mode in two search choice readers; ten preservation cases pass.

fixedDefects.name: Unfocused camera pans world out of view
fixedDefects.reproduce: Run an online client in background with pointer outside/at a window edge for 36 seconds.
fixedDefects.expected: Camera stays still while networking continues.
fixedDefects.change: Ignore camera input without application focus and edge scrolling outside window bounds; measured zero drift and visible terrain/Heroes.

security: DigitalOcean upgrade requires pinned TLS and private room access key; trusted isolated legacy fixtures retain plain TCP.
